AAPI ATLAS
Composio Product Ops take-home · Sep 2026
Evidence-first integration intelligence

The APIs exist. Access is the tax.

A rerunnable agent mapped auth, credential friction, API breadth, MCP availability and buildability across a 100-app request queue.

Honest scope: 48 apps passed schema validation before the free model quota ended; 52 remain visibly queued. The pipeline is resumable, and no unresearched row is presented as a finding.
48/100validated records
249claim-level citations
87%evidence from official sources
8apps manually spot-checked

What the first 48 reveal

The early portfolio is highly buildable, but “public API” does not mean “frictionless integration.” Authentication is usually solvable; credentials, plan entitlements and admin control decide time-to-value.

94%

Buildable now

45 of 48 have a documented surface and viable authentication. The opportunity is packaging quality, not protocol invention.

38/48

OAuth is dominant—not exclusive

OAuth and API keys/tokens frequently coexist. Treating an OAuth client ID as an API key was the fast pass’s most common taxonomy error.

20

Paid access is the common tax

Half of the validated set requires a paid self-serve account for production access. Only 2 are explicitly admin-gated; the rest are mostly accessible, but not free.

17

MCP whitespace

No credible MCP was found for 17 validated apps. Existing REST APIs make these practical toolkit opportunities rather than research projects.

21

Deep-run controls

A separate agent researched 21 apps independently. Agreement was strong on category and verdict, weaker on access and MCP—exactly where manual review adds value.

52

Unknown stays unknown

The unprocessed half is shown as queued. A funded rerun resumes from checkpoints; it does not repeat retrieval or silently fill gaps.

Coverage by request category

Three categories reached complete coverage; later categories are partial because processing stopped at the daily quota—not because the agent selected easier companies.

The agent is a pipeline

Research is deliberately split from synthesis. That makes evidence reusable, failures resumable and model substitutions measurable.

100-app manifestStable IDs and ten supplied categories.
Composio SDKCreates a scoped, read-only research session.
Composio MCPTavily discovers sources; fetch reads decisive pages.
Batch synthesisGemini extracts five evidence packets per request.
Schema gateWrong count, identity or shape fails atomically.
Human loopOfficial docs resolve high-impact disagreements.

Verification, without a vanity score

Accuracy is reported at the field level. Two agents can agree and still be wrong, so cross-run agreement locates risk; official-document checks correct it.

Official-doc spot check

Eight apps across CRM, support, messaging, ecommerce, marketing and data.

16/16decisive auth + access fields
after the correction loop
The first pass needed corrections on 7 of 8 sampled apps—mostly taxonomy, not API existence. Raw records remain preserved; corrected fields are labeled “Human checked” below.
AppOutcomeWhat changed / was confirmedProof
SalesforceCorrectedRemoved API key; Developer Edition provides self-serve API access.Official doc ↗
HubSpotCorrectedPrivate-app access tokens replace legacy API keys.Official doc ↗
ZendeskCorrectedOAuth is preferred; legacy API tokens use Basic auth and client setup requires an admin.Official doc ↗
SlackCorrectedA free workspace can create and install a Slack app; paid plan is not the credential gate.Official doc ↗
ShopifyCorrectedRequests use scoped access tokens; the app client identifier is not an API key.Official doc ↗
MailchimpCorrectedAPI keys can be created from an account; capabilities still depend on plan level.Official doc ↗
DiscordConfirmedOAuth2 and bot tokens were confirmed without a paid credential gate.Official doc ↗
DataForSEOCorrectedProduction API access uses Basic auth; a free sandbox exists, while production is pay-as-you-go.Official doc ↗

This is a verification sample, not a claim that all 48 rows were manually certified. Non-audited records remain automated findings with linked evidence.
